title: Universal Online Convex Optimization With Delayed Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.28058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study universal online convex optimization with delayed feedback. We develop a single algorithm that simultaneously adapts to general convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave losses without prior knowledge of the curvature class or parameters. Our regret bounds match the best known dependence on the time horizon $T$ and delays up to doubly logarithmic factors: roughly $\sqrt{T + d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ for convex losses and $\sigma_{\max}\log T$ rates with curved losses, where $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the total cumulative delay and $\sigma_{\max}$ is the maximum number of simultaneously missing observations. Our main technical contribution is a delayed meta-learner with a second-order excess-loss guarantee, which enables curvature-adaptive aggregation of delayed base learners. translated_title: 带延迟反馈的通用在线凸优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究带延迟反馈的通用在线凸优化问题。我们开发了一种单一算法，无需预先知道损失函数的曲率类型或参数，即可同时自适应于一般凸、强凸和指数凹损失。我们的遗憾界在时间范围 $T$ 和延迟的依赖关系上匹配了已知最优结果（仅相差双对数因子）：对于凸损失约为 $\sqrt{T + d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$，对于具有曲率的损失约为 $\sigma_{\max}\log T$ 的速率，其中 $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ 是总累积延迟，$\sigma_{\max}$ 是同时缺失观测的最大数量。我们的主要技术贡献是一个具有二阶超额损失保证的延迟元学习器，它使得能够对延迟的基础学习器进行曲率自适应聚合。此外，我们新的指数凹基础学习器产生了更紧致的遗憾界，通过用（总累积延迟）替换最大延迟，改进了现有最先进的延迟依赖性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需任何曲率先验知识即可同时自适应凸、强凸和指数凹损失的延迟反馈在线凸优化通用算法，其核心是一个带二阶超额损失保证的延迟元学习器，遗憾界在时间范围与延迟依赖上达到已知最优水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a single universal algorithm for online convex optimization with delayed feedback that simultaneously adapts to convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave losses without prior knowledge, whose key contribution is a delayed meta-learner with second-order excess-loss guarantees achieving regret bounds matching the best known dependence on time horizon and delays.
